spots.name: Desarrollo Urbano Nueva Pradera
spots.blurb: You've reached Desarrollo Urbano Nueva Pradera, a mural by Carlos Perez M.. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
